say:1:1710355001:0.text: ... Is that Chief Justice Fairfax? Oh? Viscount Urswick is there too.
say:1:1710355001:0.source_cn: ……是康拉德大法官吗？哦，还有……乌瑟斯子爵？

say:3:1710355002:0.text: Dura above, it's so great to see you safe and sound.
say:3:1710355002:0.source_cn: 公主殿下！艾雅保佑，能平安见到您真是荣幸之至。

say:6:1710355004:0.text: Seeing you here confirms my theory—we're indeed trapped inside the Hall of Ancients.
say:6:1710355004:0.source_cn: 既然您也出现在这里，那么老夫的推论就成立了——我们确实...

say:7:1710355005:0.text: If I may speak frankly, this matter can't be a random occurrence... Something more deliberate is at play.
say:7:1710355005:0.source_cn: 恕我直言，公主殿下。这件事发生得太过……巧合了。

say:8:1710355006:0.source_cn: 大法官，您这是什么意思？

say:9:1710355007:0.text: More often than not, the cause lies in what changed.
say:9:1710355007:0.source_cn: 从逻辑上来看，变量往往就是原因。

say:10:1710355008:0.text: The rite went well for Prince Orion, but disaster struck when it was Your Highness' turn.
say:10:1710355008:0.source_cn: 奥利安王子祭拜后，仪式完美结束，没有任何异常。然而，轮...

say:11:1710355009:0.text: As Chief Justice, it's my duty to examine every detail. With all due respect, did Your Highness act in strict accordance with the regulations during the rite?
say:11:1710355009:0.source_cn: 身为大法官，我有责任核实每一个细节——今日的仪式中您的...

say:12:1710355010:0.text: Is it possible... that you unknowingly committed a violation that led to this disaster?
say:12:1710355010:0.source_cn: 您是否在无意中……触犯了某种禁忌，才招致了这种祸端？

say:13:1710355011:0.source_cn: 大法官阁下，您是在审问我吗？

say:14:1710355012:0.text: I know nothing about this, and I've done nothing wrong!
say:14:1710355012:0.source_cn: 我对此事一无所知，也没有做错任何事！

say:16:1710355014:1.text: Shh! Keep it down, please! If the armors hear us, we're dead meat!
say:16:1710355014:1.source_cn: 嘘！嘘——！二位，请稍安勿躁！要是把那些巡逻的盔甲引过...

say:17:1710355015:0.text: Chief Justice, we can't afford to turn on each other in this critical situation.
say:17:1710355015:0.source_cn: 大法官，现在局势未明，我们可不能内部先乱了阵脚。

say:18:1710355016:1.text: Viscount, I'm doing this out of necessity.
say:18:1710355016:1.source_cn: 副大臣，老夫这是在进行必要的质询。

say:19:1710355017:1.text: It's our empire's blessing to have an impartial judge like you.
say:19:1710355017:1.source_cn: 大法官阁下向来持正不阿，这是耀光之幸，我等自然知晓。

say:20:1710355018:1.text: But don't you think the interrogation can wait until we're out of danger?
say:20:1710355018:1.source_cn: 但阁下，所谓的程序是否等我们脱离险境之后，再去施行？

say:21:1710355019:1.text: At a time like this, we should all rally behind Princess Peggy to find a way out.
say:21:1710355019:1.source_cn: 眼下人心惶惶，我们反倒是应该簇拥在公主殿下身边，共同寻...

say:22:1710355020:1.text: ... That's a fair point. I've let my haste get the better of me.
say:22:1710355020:1.source_cn: ……你说得有理。是老夫操之过急了。

say:23:1710355021:1.text: Your Highness, please excuse his blunt words. He acts only out of concern for the empire and means no offense.
say:23:1710355021:1.source_cn: 公主殿下，也请您宽恕大法官阁下的直言。他心系耀光，并非...

say:24:1710355022:1.text: Viscount Urswick's right. Nothing is more important than finding a way out.
say:24:1710355022:1.source_cn: 乌瑟斯卿说的没错，现在的首要任务是离开圣古堂。

say:25:1710355023:1.text: I know a <style="highlight">secret passage</style> out of the Hall of Ancients. If you're willing to set your doubts aside for now...
say:25:1710355023:1.source_cn: 我知道一条只有王室成员才知晓的、离开圣古堂的<styl...

say:26:1710355024:0.text: Chief Justice, perhaps we should follow Her Highness' lead and focus on getting out of here first.
say:26:1710355024:0.source_cn: 大法官阁下，有这样一条生路，不如暂且放下成见，听从殿下...

say:27:1710355025:0.text: ... Alright. Our safety should come first.
say:27:1710355025:0.source_cn: ……好吧。在生存危机面前，调查真相可以暂时延后。

say:28:1710355026:0.text: But both the public and I will expect a proper explanation from you once this is over.
say:28:1710355026:0.source_cn: 但请记住，事后，无论是老夫还是民众，都依然需要一个合理...
